test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

He tried to run away but was soon overtook by some policemen.
solution:
The correct answer is **Overtook by **i.e. **this part has an error.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As the sentence is in **passive **form, we need to follow the Active-Passive conversion rules.
 
• Here, **the third form** of the verb should be used.
 
• Hence, **Overtook **changed into **Overtaken**.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1.**

**The correct sentence is:** He tried to run away but was soon **overtaken **by some policemen.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In the **active voice**, the subject acts upon its verb:

 
 
• *The dog chases the ball.*
 
 
 
• In the **passive voice**, the subject receives the action from the verb:
 
 
• *The ball is chased by the dog. *
